# Infynix Solutions - The Growth Engineering Company

> Infynix Solutions is a premier Growth Engineering firm. We unify technical SEO engineering, performance media, custom web/app software, AI agents, and AI surveillance solutions into cohesive growth engines.

## Primary Business Pillars

### 1. Infynix Agency (Marketing & Advertising)
- **Paid Media & Performance Advertising**: Scalable customer acquisition across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and LinkedIn Ads.
- **SEO Engineering**: Technical SEO architecture, sub-second pre-rendering, programmatic landing page engines, structured JSON-LD schemas, and semantic keyword cluster dominance.
- **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**: Funnel architecture, landing page optimization, behavioral tracking, and data-backed A/B experimentation.

### 2. Infynix Media (Branding & Production)
- **Brand Identity & Design**: Strategic positioning, messaging frameworks, visual identity systems, and UI/UX product design.
- **Cinematic Production**: High-end brand films, broadcast commercials, studio photography, and 3D motion graphics.
- **Short-Form & Social Content**: High-retention vertical video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) designed for organic algorithmic reach.

### 3. Infynix Growth Solutions (Software & AI Surveillance)
- **Custom Software & Web Engineering**: High-performance web applications, React/Next.js architectures, progressive web apps, and native mobile apps (iOS & Android).
- **AI Agents & LLM Integration**: Autonomous AI agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, and workflow automation connected to enterprise CRMs/ERPs.
- **AI Surveillance & Security Solutions**: Real-time computer vision pipelines, edge AI hardware processing (NVIDIA Jetson & Google Coral), automated threat/intrusion profiling, and smart CCTV network analytics.

## Core Technology Stack
- **Frontend & Web**: React 19, Next.js, Vite 8, React Router 7, Framer Motion, GSAP.
- **Backend & AI**: Node.js, Express, Python, OpenAI/Claude APIs, LangChain, RAG Vector Databases.
- **Edge & Computer Vision**: OpenCV, YOLO, NVIDIA Jetson, Google Coral, RTSP/CCTV Stream Gateways.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, GCP, Vercel, Docker, CI/CD pipelines.
